purpose: Ask for one bounded answer whose token, character, word and byte costs are recorded, so token economy is measured against a task a model can actually complete.
template:
{{ task }}

Answer directly. Do not restate the question.

task.description: The question or instruction whose answer's token cost is being measured.

expectations: A direct answer. Length is the measurement, so no length is wrong; the scorer only records that an answer arrived.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.token_economy needs one prompt record so its manifest can declare a prompt subset hash.
